query:
SELECT 
  e.inep,
  e.nome AS escola,
  e.municipio,
  COALESCE(e.endereco, '') AS endereco,
  COALESCE(t_os.nome, t_esc.nome, 'Sem técnico') AS tecnico,
  COALESCE(os.status, 'sem_os') AS status
FROM escolas e
LEFT JOIN ordens_servico os ON os.escolaId = e.id
LEFT JOIN tecnicos t_os ON t_os.id = os.tecnicoId
LEFT JOIN tecnicos t_esc ON t_esc.id = e.tecnicoId
WHERE e.inep IN (
  '29153301','29055032','29055237','29077575','29112885','29113148','29113440','29113539',
  '29118867','29119049','29119367','29122740','29122961','29124433','29124450','29131510',
  '29136083','29151503','29153310','29153522','29401770'
)
ORDER BY COALESCE(t_os.nome, t_esc.nome) ASC, e.municipio ASC, e.nome ASC;
